Class DraftApplicationsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.DraftApplicationsController
@RequestMapping("/api/draftApplications") @RestController public class DraftApplicationsController extends ApiController
An applicant's drafts: applications as they are being filled in (issue #270).

A draft is saved without being checked. Nothing is required of it and no rule about the form is applied, because the point is never to lose what the applicant has typed, and what they have typed so far may be anything. All the rules apply, unchanged, when the application is submitted.

Like the applications controller, every read and write confirms the draft is the current user's.
